title: Second-Order Thinking
hook: That discount spiked sales and trained customers to wait for the next.
statement: Think past the first result. Every move has downstream effects.
explainer: You see the first effect. The third one is what bites you.
sop: Write the first result you expect.
Write what that causes, then what follows.
Score each effect, then add them.
equation_example: 1st 8 + 2nd 4 + 3rd -3 = True Impact 9. Strong start, weaker finish.
question: Take your next decision. Write what happens after that.
closing_statement: Always ask what happens after what happens.
